steps.prompt: Look back at your first essay unit. What can you do now that you couldn’t then?

cards.title: Everything you have learned
cards.body: Grammar that agrees. Paragraphs with topic sentences, evidence and explanations. An introduction that hooks and ends with a thesis. Body paragraphs that prove it. A conclusion that restates and leaves a final thought. Formal, precise, concise words.

cards.title: From draft to final
cards.body: Your final essay starts from your Lesson 5 draft. Give it a title on the first line, then revise in passes and work through the final essay checklist until every item is done.

cards.title: How the final works
cards.body: First, a 10-question style and revision quiz: you need 8 right (80%) to pass. Then polish and submit your final essay. Quill gives it a score with its strengths and next steps. Well done for getting here!

prompts: What are you proudest of in your final essay?
What will you do the same way next time you write an essay?
